service.method: SELECT DOC_TYPE ,COMPANY_CODE ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,DESCRIPTION ,DEL_FLAG ,HOUSE_CODE FROM SDCGL WHERE 1=1 AND nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND ( UPPER(DESCRIPTION) like '%' || upper($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(DOC_TYPE) like '%' || upper($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(ADD_USER_ID) like '%' || upper($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(ADD_DATE) like '%' || upper($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' AND 1=1 ) ORDER BY DOC_TYPE
SELECT DOC_TYPE ,COMPANY_CODE ,PLANT_CODE ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,DESCRIPTION ,DEL_FLAG ,HOUSE_CODE FROM SDCGL WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND DOC_TYPE = ${DOC_TYPE}

SELECT DOC_TYPE ,SEQ ,COMPANY_CODE ,PLANT_CODE ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,PREFIX_FORMAT ,START_NO ,END_NO ,CURRENT_NO ,USE_FLAG ,YEAR_FLAG ,MONTH_FLAG ,DAY_FLAG ,ADD_TIME ,CHANGE_TIME ,DEL_FLAG FROM SDCLN WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND DOC_TYPE = ${DOC_TYPE}

INSERT INTO SCODE ( HOUSE_CODE, TYPE, CODE, LANGUAGE, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, FLAG, SORT_SEQ, USE_FLAG, IF_FLAG, TEXT1, TEXT2, TEXT3, TEXT4, TEXT5, TEXT6, TEXT7, TEXT8, DEL_FLAG, ACC_DATE ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, 'M999', ${CODE}, ${session.LANGUAGE}, ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}, ${session.ID}, ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}, ${session.ID}, ${FLAG}, '1', 'Y', 'N', ${DESCRIPTION}, ${TEXT2}, ${TEXT3}, ${TEXT4}, ${TEXT5}, ${TEXT6}, ${TEXT7}, ${TEXT8}, 'N', ${current.DATE} )
SELECT a.DOC_TYPE FROM SDCLN a JOIN SCODE b ON a.DOC_TYPE = b.CODE AND a.DOC_TYPE = ${DOC_TYPE} AND b.TYPE = 'M999'
SELECT SEQ FROM SDCLN WHERE DEL_FLAG = 'Y' AND SEQ = ${SEQ}
